title: Card Grading Costs (2026)
verdict: Card grading costs are the fee plus shipping, insurance and supplies, and at AGS the fee is a flat $18 a card with nothing added for the card's value.

For comparison, CGC's bulk tier is $10 a card with a 10-card minimum, Beckett's Base tier is $14.95, ISA charges a flat $15, PSA's open value tiers run $24.99 to $79.99, and SGC's base price was reported at $50 in September 2026. Prices moved several times this year, so confirm before you ship.

why: There is no value upcharge. A $20 card and a $20,000 card cost the same $18 to grade at AGS, and bulk orders of 30 or more start at $15. Subgrades and the report are included, where Beckett charges $3 more for subgrades at its Base tier.
Turnaround is counted in days. AGS quotes 20 business days or less from the day your cards are confirmed, with 10 and 5 business day bulk tiers at $20 and $30 a card.
You can send one card. AGS has no minimum and no membership fee, takes payment only when the cards are graded, and lets you cancel before grading starts. Bulk pricing begins at 30 cards.

faq.q: What are the card grading costs?
faq.a: Most entry tiers cost $10 to $50 a card in November 2026. AGS is $18 with subgrades and a report included.

faq.q: Which card grader has the lowest listed price?
faq.a: As of November 18, 2026, GMA is lowest at $12 a card with a 25-card minimum, or $9 at 100 cards. CGC's bulk tier is $10 with a 10-card minimum on cards worth up to $500. Beckett's Base tier is $14.95, and ISA and AGS bulk are $15.

faq.q: What costs come on top of the grading fee?
faq.a: Shipping to the grader, return shipping and insurance, and supplies such as penny sleeves and card savers. Some graders add membership fees, subgrade fees or value upcharges. AGS adds return shipping at checkout.

faq.q: When do you pay for grading?
faq.a: AGS charges when the cards are graded and ready to ship, not when you submit.

faq.q: How much does AGS charge to grade a card?
faq.a: $18 per card at the standard rate, whatever the card is worth. Bulk orders of 30 or more TCG cards are $15 each at 20 business days, $20 at 10 or $30 at 5. Sports and non-TCG bulk is $3 more per tier.
